title: Recorded UK imports: sugar (HS 1701)
coverage: UK recorded imports from all partners (EU and non-EU import flows); GB and Northern Ireland
attribution: Source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics (uktradeinfo). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

retrieval.method: HMRC OTS API, server-side $apply aggregation; raw responses cached in pipeline/raw/hmrc/
retrieval.source: 2 queries over consecutive runs of the basket's CN8 codes (URL length), first: https://api.uktradeinfo.com/OTS?$apply=filter(MonthId%20ge%20201901%20and%20(FlowTypeId%20eq%201%20or%20FlowTypeId%20eq%203)%20and%20(CommodityId%20eq%2017011110%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017011190%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017011210%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017011290%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017011310%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017011390%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017011410%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017011490%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017019100%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%2017019910))/groupby((MonthId,FlowTypeId,CountryId,CommodityId,SuppressionIndex),aggregate(NetMass%20with%20sum%20as%20SumNetMass,Value%20with%20sum%20as%20SumValue,$count%20as%20Rows))
retrieval.notes: CN8 codes: 17011110, 17011190, 17011210, 17011290, 17011310, 17011390, 17011410, 17011490, 17019100, 17019910, 17019990. Import flows 1 (EU) and 3 (non-EU) summed. Partner = country of dispatch recorded by HMRC. Suppressed trade kept separately. Latest month confirmed by probing the following month. Months from provisionalFrom are within HMRC's 18-month revision window (estimated from publication lag).
